result:
Fix is in; the test run is still going in the background.

The two parsers in `anthrouter/config.py` (`_parse_model_aliases_str` and `_parse_classification_str`) now raise `ValueError` instead of calling `p.error()`. They no longer take a parser argument. `parse_args()` catches the `ValueError` and calls `p.error()`, so CLI behavior is unchanged. In `anthrouter/admin.py`, `POST /admin/config` catches it and returns 400 with the message, so the `garbage` value no longer kills the request.

I have not confirmed the fix yet. `pytest` isn't installed here, and the `uv run` suite exceeded the 120s timeout. I'll report the result when it finishes. No existing test references the two parsers.
